description: Pass a call through, unchanged, to a reflow2 tool this list leaves out. It reaches every reflow2 tool not in this list: put the name in `tool` and its own arguments in `arguments`, exactly as they would be passed to it directly. Call `find_tools` first, with the job in your own words: it gives that name and its full argument rules (each found tool's input schema, the same schema tools/list serves). The reply is the other tool's own reply, passed back unchanged, refusals included: a name nothing serves is refused as calling it directly is refused, and a write is checked, signed and recorded exactly as the same write made directly. Served in every profile: a lite session is listed 45 tools and reaches the rest through this one. It never calls itself.

arguments.description:
That tool's own arguments, as one object, exactly as you would pass
them to it directly. `find_tools` gives each tool's input schema.
Omitted, the tool is called with no arguments.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

tool.description:
The name of the reflow2 tool to call, exactly as `find_tools` gives it
— "topic_report", "what_next". Any served tool; not `use_another_tool`.

name: use_another_tool
title: Use Another Tool
